//: Copy to ~/.config/prompt-improver/settings.json or .prompt-improver/settings.json. Keys starting with // are comments only (ignored). Full guides: docs/CUSTOM-BACKENDS.md, references/models-supported.md. Shipped tables: config/runtime-defaults.json.
//backend: auto | claude | grok | gemini | codex | agy | copilot | cursor | opencode | cline | qwen | droid | amp | kimi | kiro — Env: PROMPT_IMPROVER_BACKEND
//model: Force one model (null = default_models[backend]). Env: PROMPT_IMPROVER_MODEL. Per-prompt model:<id> wins.
//default_models: Generator model per CLI when model is null. null = leave the CLI's own default (multi-provider CLIs use their own model ids). claude uses the `opus` alias, which tracks the newest Opus.
//headless_only: true = host must not in-session rewrite when headless fails
//allow_web_search: false = no web search in generated executor instructions
//allow_code_execution_in_generation: false = generator cannot run gather-context.sh or shell
//backend_invocation: scripts | commands | auto — how built-in CLIs are invoked
//preferred_backends: Order to try OTHER generators after the primary fails — not the default pick. kimi is left out because its -p mode auto-approves tools.
//custom_command: Escape hatch: prompt on stdin, improved text on stdout. Bypasses backends. Env: PROMPT_IMPROVER_CUSTOM_COMMAND
//model_aliases: Override/extend alias→canonical map (merged with runtime-defaults.json). Example:
//model_fallback_chains: Replace entire chain table when set. Example:
//backend_commands: Override CLI templates (used when backend_invocation is commands, or auto with an override here). Placeholders: {prompt_file} {model} {model_args} {max_tokens}; {model} is shell-quoted. Keep generators read-only.
notes:
Default pick: host CLI + default_models (not first-on-PATH). Override any runtime-defaults.json key in this file. model: routes by family. No host generator → HOST_BOUNCE:NO_HEADLESS.
Generation materials + context_mode: see generation object / runtime-defaults.json.

generation.output_instructions: Output ONLY the final improved XML prompt. No explanation, no code fences, no commentary, no execution of the request.

//generation: Customise generation materials and deterministic context. Full defaults: config/runtime-defaults.json → generation
//fast_path: EXPERIMENTAL Jev fast path (off | auto | ground). Opt-in: sends the redacted request and repo facts (file cards, rule sentences, the target file's header) to TypeSafe/OpenRouter. Full options: config/runtime-defaults.json → fast_path. Env: PROMPT_IMPROVER_FAST_PATH
